status: v0.3 broadly supported; v0.4 feedback changes awaiting review
scope: Interactive wireframe, not final visual styling. Right workspace is user-directed adaptation. Tool actions and artifact content are samples.

items.title: Application identity
items.user: Do not say Netrok or Netrok Muse … choose another name.
items.observed: The previous wireframe did not reserve a clear application identity position. The user now explicitly requests it.
items.mismatch: Application branding and the agent avatar were not sufficiently distinguished.
items.proposal: Aven is the proposed working name. Keep the name beside a reserved logo position in the top-left header until a recognizable logo is agreed. Agent identity remains separate.
items.unknown: Working name and final logo artwork await user agreement. No trademark or availability check is claimed.
items.check: Product identity remains visible when the agent or artifact panel opens; it is not confused with the agent identity.

items.title: Avatar & identity
items.user: The Muse is an interactive avatar … I am not able to click on the agent itself.
items.observed: The reference shows a small avatar in the rail and a larger avatar, name, status and controls in the agent panel.
items.mismatch: The prototype substitutes a wordmark and an invented Atlas card for the agent identity and entry point.
items.proposal: Keep the agent avatar separate from the application identity. Selecting it opens the agent workspace on the right, preserving the central conversation.
items.unknown: Exact opening transition, animation and whether the avatar is 3D remain unverified.
items.check: Demonstrate the avatar at rest and on selection, then show where the user lands. Obtain visual agreement before choosing artwork.

items.title: Icon-only navigation
items.user: The sidebar collapse button … on the right side … is confusing.
items.observed: The Feed frame has a narrow icon rail, avatar and a toggle. The video and transcript establish Chat, Feed, Ideas and Goals; library is discussed later.
items.mismatch: The prototype omits destinations and does not reproduce the collapse interaction the user expects.
items.proposal: Place the sidebar toggle at the bottom of the left rail, immediately above Settings. It only expands or collapses left navigation; the right workspace is unaffected. Use a conventional rounded speech bubble.
items.unknown: Icon-only navigation is the recommended response to this feedback. Exact final icon style and optional label toggle still await visual agreement.
items.check: Toggle left navigation while the right workspace is open: only the left rail changes. Verify hover/focus labels and the clearer chat icon.

items.title: Agent & document workspace
items.coverage: User-directed placement; reference panel contents partly observed
items.user: Conversation will be in the center … agent appearance, motion … should open on the right-hand side.
items.observed: An agent panel has avatar, status, tabs, Edit and SOUL/MEMORY cards. A larger adjacent workspace opens MEMORY.md or SOUL.md; the SOUL editor has Save and close controls.
items.mismatch: A task evidence drawer was treated as if it also represented the agent's identity, memory and capabilities.
items.proposal: Move the agent workspace to the right as explicitly requested, even though the inspected reference showed it on the left. Open SOUL.md and MEMORY.md inside that right workspace. Keep chat and its draft visible.
flow: Back to agent / close → retain chat
items.unknown: Browser/computer panel details, tab meanings and unsaved-edit handling still need evidence or an explicit design decision.
items.check: Verify the agent, its documents and settings open to the right of chat at desktop width. Switching panels and closing them must preserve the draft.

items.title: Artifacts & right panel
items.coverage: User request; library transcript support; proposed layout
items.user: Where will the artifacts … documents or web artifacts … where will the right shell be?
items.observed: The video transcript discusses outputs retained in a library. Exact desktop artifact preview layout has not been fully inspected.
items.mismatch: The first map omitted a clear place for generated documents and web artifacts.
items.proposal: Use Artifacts in the left navigation as the single library entry. Remove duplicate artifact buttons from chat and the right-hand tab strip. Selecting a saved output opens its preview in the right workspace.
flow: Select document or web output → right preview
Back to library / close → retain chat
items.unknown: Expanded previews, export/edit actions and durable storage will need later design decisions. Displayed artifacts are wireframe samples.
items.check: Open both output types through the left Artifacts entry, return to its list and preserve the conversation draft.

items.title: Browser & plugin requests
items.coverage: User request; browser transcript support; proposed flow
items.user: Inside the chat … do connect to this plugin or use the browser … that is also not visible.
items.observed: The transcript describes browser tasks. The user explicitly asks for plugin connection and browser interactions to be visible in chat.
items.mismatch: The first map skipped how a chat request leads to a capability workspace or connection review.
items.proposal: Represent tool requests as chat cards with an entry into the right workspace. Browser shows task/result content; Plugins shows provider, requested access and connection state. Keep requests visible in the conversation.
flow: Review result / connection state → return to chat
items.unknown: Real provider selection, consent, credentials, execution, cancellation and failures remain to be specified. This wireframe performs no external operation.
items.check: Open browser and plugin requests from chat. Preview a browser result and a connection state without implying a real execution or connection.

items.title: Settings & preferences
items.user: The setting logo is also very weird. It is not matching my vibe.
items.observed: The inspected frames do not establish the complete settings experience. No reference settings layout is claimed here.
items.mismatch: A two-field dialog was presented without first identifying the reference's settings structure and contents.
items.proposal: Use a symmetric cog icon in the bottom-left control group, next to the sidebar control area. Keep application preferences separate from agent settings.
items.unknown: Settings layout, full categories, defaults and save behavior are unresolved. Do not invent a finished settings screen.
items.check: Review the settings reference or an explicitly proposed alternative. Theme saving already works in the prototype; the user corrected that complaint.

items.title: Conversation & composer
items.user: This send button is not looking okay and is a bit off to me in the wireframe.
items.observed: The main chat frame establishes the conversation area, narrow rail and separate activity area. Exact send-control states are not yet confirmed.
items.mismatch: The prototype uses its own send treatment and visual spacing. Working submission does not establish reference fidelity.
items.proposal: Use a compact rounded-square arrow control integrated into the composer, with muted empty and blue ready states. Show tool requests and artifact cards within the conversation.
items.unknown: This is a revised send-control proposal, not an approved reference match. Final spacing, colors and chat states need the next visual prototype.
items.check: Compare empty and typed states. Check send proportions, central chat width and draft preservation while right-hand views change.

items.title: Computer workspace
items.user: We do have a computer use on the left- or right-hand side … that is also not there.
items.observed: The user explicitly requests a computer-use surface. Exact reference desktop-control states are not established by the inspected frames.
items.mismatch: The previous wireframe included Browser but omitted a separate Computer workspace.
items.proposal: Add a Computer tab in the right workspace and a computer request card in chat. Show the selected desktop, action sequence and session controls as a clearly labelled preview.
flow: Select Computer or its chat request
items.unknown: Real screen access, execution, permissions, interruption and failure behavior remain unimplemented. No desktop is being controlled.
items.check: Open Computer from chat and from its right-side tab, preview the session and return. Distinguish Computer from Browser and actual execution from a wireframe.

userDecision.source: Latest wireframe feedback in this conversation
userDecision.supported: Chat shell and composer; overall wireframe direction
userDecision.requested: Clearer icons; bottom-left sidebar toggle; single artifact library; computer-use view; original application name
userDecision.notApproved: Aven working name, final icons/logo/artwork, full settings, live tool integrations or full build
